notes: The supplied PDF is a detailed syllabus outline; lesson prose, code examples, question prompts and vectors are original CodeLeaf educational expansions.

ISO lists ISO/IEC 14882:2024 as the published C++ standard (Edition 7, published 2024-10). The next ISO/IEC DIS 14882 revision is under development as of the review date; C++26 topics are explicitly marked exploratory/draft.
Feature support differs between compiler front ends and standard-library implementations. Check the individual feature table, official compiler status page and your actual toolchain version.
The C++ Core Guidelines are living community guidance, not the ISO language standard. Treat them as recommendations to evaluate against project constraints.
C++ language examples are intended for local compilation with C++20 mode and warnings; CodeLeaf does not execute arbitrary C++ in its FastAPI process.
